applicability.rationale: The change fixes consequential realization shape needed for independent implementation and review.

delegated.bounds: May change if fixed public/runtime contracts, ownership, effects and touchpoint evidence remain intact.

fixed.statement: No semantic type-check pass may be claimed unless a checker is explicitly added and run.

prohibited: Duplicating the same runtime schema or authoritative rule in independently mutable layers.
Treating a TypeScript declaration or transpiler pass as runtime validation.

acceptanceCriteria: Fixed public/shared contracts and owners are explicit.
Delegated freedom preserves competent private implementation choices.
The first execution slice creates an inspectable integrated touchpoint.

failureAndRecovery: Failure is typed or otherwise classified and leaves the declared recoverable state.
behaviorPaths.name: Transpile-only TypeScript structure
behaviorPaths.success: The declared touchpoint produces the accepted behavior.
behaviorPaths.trigger: A declared consumer invokes the slice

failureSemantics: build success does not imply type correctness
keyContracts.name: Runtime entry
keyContracts.responsibility: Runtime behavior, not a type-safety claim

observabilityPoints.statement: Record outcome class and correlation identity without secrets.

testSeams.statement: Exercise the declared public/runtime boundary through a deterministic fixture or clean consumer.

subject.purpose: Keep emit evidence distinct from absent semantic type-check evidence.
